remarks: Totally transformed - English countryside meets classic CT! Prominently sited on ~1.3 private acres in the highly coveted South of the YMCA neighborhood, this stunning colonial estate offers an unparalleled lifestyle. Located just minutes from the heart of downtown New Canaan, Waveny Park, and top-rated schools, this extraordinary home is a rare gem. Thoughtfully transformed by its current owners, blending timeless charm with modern sophistication. This meticulously updated residence boasts 4+ spacious bedrooms, with 3.5 stunning baths, providing luxury and privacy. Every detail in this jewel box has been considered all the way down to the ultra high-end lighting, designer wallpaper, specialty paints, and SO much more. Bright and sun-drenched, the home's interiors exude warmth and character, creating a welcoming space for both relaxation and entertaining. This home is truly one-of-a-kind. Step outside and discover a true private oasis: lush manicured grounds, stunning flower beds and mature plantings. The sparkling pool, outdoor patio with fireplace & wraparound porch complete this outdoor paradise, offering the perfect setting for leisurely days or vibrant gatherings. This home is not just a property, but a lifestyle. It's the perfect combination of luxury, comfort, & convenience, and it's ready for you to move in & enjoy. Experience the best of New England living-bring your toothbrush & get ready to immerse yourself in the unparalleled beauty of this extraordinary property.
